lines.text: Zooming a photo is smooth now: it stays under your fingers and keeps its sharp detail until a sharper one is ready.
A flick glides on, the edges give a little and spring back, and a double tap zooms in or out smoothly.
Export on this phone says Download: each photo goes to Downloads in turn, and for more than three you can share.
Photos keeps uploading from this phone when you leave the app or lock the screen, on Android Chrome.
